corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez plural imperative of ቀድሐ with object suffix -ዎን is ቅድኅዎንኬ (with 6th-order ኅ, matching ቀድኅዎ in L37 and the visible top hook on ኅ in the image).
Classical Ge'ez causative imperfective of ሰትየ ('to give to drink') is ያስቲ with 6th-order ስ, which is clearly visible in the print.

The Andemta theological phrase is 'ስቴ ሕይወት ስቴ መድኃኒት' ('drink of life, drink of salvation', interpreting the wine of Cana via the Ge'ez noun ስቴ). The 5th-order vowel loop on ቴ is visible on the right leg.
The noun is ስቴ ('drink') in 'ስቴ ሕይወት ስቴ መድኃኒት'; the 5th-order loop on ቴ is visible in the image.
